title: Старый друг и ложная тревога  (An Old Friend and a False Alarm)

scenes.title: The Summer Menu
scenes.summary: Vika confronts Chef Barinov for stalling on the new summer menu for two months, and complains to Dmitry Nagiyev as summer nears its end.

scenes.title: Jokes About Retirement
scenes.summary: Nagiyev jokes that Chef Barinov is getting old and ready for retirement, while a foreign guest arrives asking for Katya.

scenes.title: A Guest from Paris
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov welcomes his old Parisian colleague Paul, while Katya admits to Max that Paul knows she was expelled from the Paris culinary academy.

scenes.title: Katya's Unexpected News
scenes.summary: Fearing Paul exposed her expulsion, Katya tells her father she is pregnant and blames Max when Barinov demands to know who the father is.

scenes.title: A Tricky Translation
scenes.summary: Katya begs Paul not to tell her father about her expulsion and mistranslates Paul's words to Nagiyev to get Paul out of the restaurant quickly.

scenes.title: Interrogation in the Walk-in Fridge
scenes.summary: Chef Barinov confronts Max in the walk-in fridge over Katya's pregnancy claim, while Max insists that nothing ever happened between them.

scenes.title: Old Furniture and a Wedding
scenes.summary: Max accidentally confirms Katya saw him undressed, prompting Barinov to order him to marry her, while Nagiyev tells Vika they must replace the old restaurant furniture.

scenes.title: The Chef Takes Charge
scenes.summary: Misinterpreting Nagiyev's talk about replacing old furniture with something French, Chef Barinov tries to prove he is still indispensable by personally cooking Nagiyev and Vika's order.

scenes.title: Nagiyev's Burned Lunch
scenes.summary: Barinov catches Max grabbing Katya, confiscates Max's passport so he cannot flee to Voronezh, and accidentally burns Nagiyev's lunch in the process.

scenes.title: A Conversation in the Courtyard
scenes.summary: Katya tells Vika her pregnancy is fake to teach Max a lesson, while Kostya advises Max to demand a pregnancy test to prove his innocence.

scenes.title: The Chef's Late-Night Menu
scenes.summary: Nagiyev wakes Chef Barinov at two in the afternoon; Barinov claims he stayed up inventing the new menu, but accidentally spills hot sauce when his numb arm fails him.

scenes.title: A Bet for Three Paychecks
scenes.summary: Max bets three months of his salary that a pregnancy test will prove Katya is lying, and Barinov sends Katya to the guest restroom to take it.

scenes.title: The Test Result
scenes.summary: The swapped pregnancy test shows positive, costing Max his bet; when Barinov chases Max shouting across the restaurant, Nagiyev sends Barinov home.

scenes.title: The Secret of the Dish and a Clever Plan
scenes.summary: Paul compliments Katya's molecular cooking and goes to the kitchen with her, while Max tells Kostya he knows Katya is bluffing and plans his payback.

scenes.title: A Short Vacation for the Chef
scenes.summary: Seeing how tired Chef Barinov looks, Nagiyev orders him to take a few days off to rest while the kitchen crew handles service.

scenes.title: The Chef's Suspicions
scenes.summary: Suspicious of Nagiyev's sudden kindness, Barinov stops by the kitchen to get his things and sees Paul cooking in a chef's uniform.

scenes.title: Scandal in the Kitchen
scenes.summary: Barinov accuses Paul of taking his job; in response, Paul reveals that Katya was expelled from the culinary academy in Paris.

scenes.title: The Talk About Furniture and Partnership
scenes.summary: Vika and Nagiyev explain they were only talking about replacing the old furniture, and Nagiyev tells Barinov he just ruined his chance to become a business partner.

scenes.title: Katya's Confession and Max's Mom
scenes.summary: Katya confesses to her relieved father that she is not pregnant, right before Max arrives with an actress posing as his mother to plan the wedding.

scenes.title: Max's Counter-Prank
scenes.summary: Max's prank forces Katya to admit she already told her father the truth, and Max reflects on the secret fears everyone keeps locked away.
